instructions.question: What sentiment does this Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post express: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Positive = praise, thanks, congratulations, blessings, get-well wishes, hope, or supportive advice (even if it also contains a request or mild worry). Negative = accusing the institute of lying or manipulating numbers, conspiracy claims, insults, cursing, blaming government or careless people, mockery. Neutral = bare name tags, questions, factual or statistical remarks, regional banter, jokes or observations without clear approval or hostility; mocking or distrustful tone pushes to negative.

neutral.what: Name tags alone, informational questions, statistics, regional comparisons, predictions, idle jokes or chatter without clear stance.
examples: Valdete Uka
Prej cilit vend janë (Which place are they from)
Ferizaji per Kosoven ështe si rasti i Suedis per Evropë (Ferizaj is to Kosovo what Sweden is to Europe)
Pse sot pa tabel (Why no table today)
neutral.cues: tagged names only, qka/qysh/pse questions (what/how/why), numbers and city names, hahaha banter, emojis only
neutral.not_for: Questions implying lying or manipulation ("Pse nuk tregoni... jeni ka manipuloni") are negative; a tag plus praise ("Ali Kastrati mire") is positive.

positive.what: Gratitude, respect or praise for doctors/institute/minister, congratulations to the recovered, prayers, hope that cases fall, constructive pleas to stay safe.
examples: Ju lumt ju jeni heroj (Well done, you are heroes)
Urime të shëruarve! (Congratulations to the recovered!)
Zoti na ndihmoft inshallah (May God help us, inshallah)
Pse si publikoni edhe te shëruarit nga vijnë me Komuna ?Për angazhimin ju lumtë (Why not publish where the recovered are from by municipality? Well done for your engagement)
positive.cues: ju lumt (well done), bravo, respekt (respect), urime (congratulations), faleminderit/flm (thanks), sherim te shpejt (quick recovery), shyqyr/elhamdulilah (thank God), ishalla (hopefully), lajm i mire (good news)
positive.not_for: Relief jokes about late posting without praise are neutral; praise of the institute combined with insulting other commenters can still be negative.

negative.what: Distrust of the numbers, claims of lies or propaganda, anger at government, politicians or irresponsible citizens, curses, insults, sarcasm and despair.
examples: Mos rreni ma shum (Stop lying more)
+77 rrena (+77 lies)
Plandemia 100% propagand
Mjert na cfar populli (Poor us, what a people)
negative.cues: rreni/rrena/rrejt (lie/lies), propagand, manipuloni (manipulate), turp (shame), zoti ju vraft/mallkoft (may God kill/curse you), qifsha (vulgar curse), pare (money), STOP
negative.not_for: Advice to stay home without blame or insults is positive or neutral; laughing banter between tagged friends is neutral.
